description: FREQROL-A800 high-performance inverter with Modbus RTU on the RS-485 terminals
source: Mitsubishi Electric FR-A800 Instruction Manual (Detailed) IB(NA)-0600503ENG-N (2312), MODBUS RTU communication specification

sources.title: FR-A800 Instruction Manual (Detailed), IB(NA)-0600503ENG-N (2312)
sources.note: Section 5.15.6, MODBUS RTU communication specification (registers on pages 713 to 716); monitor register numbers in section 5.11 (page 464 onwards); linked in issue #189

notes: The manual numbers the registers 40001 and up; this map uses address_base 1, so address 201 is register 40201 and goes on the wire as 200.

Registers: 40002 to 40015 system environment variables, 40201 and up the real-time monitor, 40501 to 40508 the fault history, 41000 plus the parameter number for Pr. 0 to 999 (Pr. 1 is 41001), 44000 plus the number for Pr. 1000 to 1999, 44001 and up the product profile.

Register 40009 holds the control input instruction when written and the inverter status when read; 40010 sets the operation mode when written and gives the mode status when read, so each is listed twice with a different access.
Write the set frequency to 40014 (RAM) for continuous changes and to 40015 (EEPROM) only for values to keep; the EEPROM has a limited number of writes. Pr. 342 = 1 sends parameter writes to RAM only.

MODBUS RTU is available on the RS-485 terminals only, not on the PU connector, and the inverter must be in the NET operation mode to accept commands (Pr. 79, Pr. 340). Pr. 549 = 1 selects MODBUS RTU. Reset the inverter after changing the communication parameters.
With a communication option installed and Pr. 550 = 9999 (initial value), commands sent through the RS-485 terminals are invalid.

Initial values: Pr. 332 = 96 (9600 bit/s), Pr. 334 = 2 (even parity, 1 stop bit). The initial station number Pr. 331 = 0 is broadcast and the inverter does not answer, so the unit_id here is 1, which must be set in Pr. 331. MODBUS RTU always uses 8 data bits.

Monitor values depend on the inverter capacity (0.01 or 0.1 steps for current, power and energy, see the register descriptions) and on Pr. 37, Pr. 144 and Pr. 811 for speed units. Negative values need Pr. 1018. A 32-bit parameter or monitor value above 0xFFFF is returned as 0xFFFF.

Only a selection of parameters and monitor items is listed (those that need an option or a control mode are mostly left out); any parameter can be reached at 41000 plus its number. The analog calibration parameters C2 to C45 use special registers in the 41900, 42000 and 43900 ranges (see the manual). The fault list holds the data codes with a known panel indication; other codes read in the fault history are listed in section 6.4 of the manual.

registers.name: Deceleration time (Pr. 8)

registers.name: Electronic thermal O/L relay (Pr. 9)
registers.description: Rated motor current; the increment is 0.01 A for the smaller capacities and 0.1 A for the larger ones (see the manual)

registers.name: Speed display (Pr. 37)
registers.description: 0 = frequency display, 1 to 9998 = speed display at 60 Hz

registers.name: Parameter write selection (Pr. 77)
registers.description: 0 = write only when stopped, 1 = no write, 2 = write in any mode

registers.name: Reverse rotation prevention selection (Pr. 78)
registers.description: 0 = both directions, 1 = reverse prevented, 2 = forward prevented

registers.name: Operation mode selection (Pr. 79)
registers.description: Selects the operation mode; see the Pr. 79 table in the manual

registers.name: RS-485 communication station number (Pr. 331)
registers.description: 0 = broadcast (no reply), 1 to 247 = station number; reset the inverter after changing

registers.name: RS-485 communication speed (Pr. 332)
registers.description: Setting x 100 = bit/s

registers.name: RS-485 communication stop bit length / data length (Pr. 333)
registers.description: With MODBUS RTU the stop bit length is set by Pr. 334 (the data length is fixed at 8 bits)

registers.name: Communication startup mode selection (Pr. 340)
registers.description: 0 = start in the mode set by Pr. 79, 1 = network mode, 2 = network mode (PU mode on restart), 10 and 12 = network mode, operation mode switchable from the panel

registers.name: Communication EEPROM write selection (Pr. 342)
registers.description: 0 = parameters written by communication go to EEPROM and RAM, 1 = RAM only

registers.name: Communication error count (Pr. 343)
registers.description: Cleared on a power reset or inverter reset

registers.name: Stop mode selection at communication error (Pr. 502)
registers.description: 0 to 4, 11 or 12; see the manual

registers.name: MODBUS RTU communication check time interval (Pr. 539)
registers.description: 0 = communication allowed but output shut off in the NET operation mode, 0.1 to 999.8 s = signal-loss detection time, 9999 = no check

registers.name: Protocol selection (Pr. 549)
registers.description: Set to 1 for MODBUS RTU; reset the inverter after changing
